record.question: In the figure below, AC 7 cm, OB = 2cm, the area of the shaded region is:
record.explanation: AC is the7cm diameter, so the quadrant radius OD=OC=3.5cm. B lies INSIDE OC and OB=2cm; it is not the radius endpoint. Shaded area = quadrant ODC − triangle ODB = π×3.5²/4 − (3.5×2)/2. With the standard exam approximation π=22/7 this is9.625−3.5=6.125cm², optionB. Using mathematicalπ gives approximately6.121cm²; the printed option follows22/7. Review note: Supersedes first-pass incorrect radius2 and no-option hold. Root visually inspected originalp12 and recomputed geometry. Verified solution (unofficial); original PDF and derivation reviewed26October2026.
